title: WF5 per-sample metadata.json
description: Schema for the C6 (COLLATE) per-sample handoff record — the Taxodactyl handoff artifact, biosecurity audit trail (CONSTITUTION.md rule 16) and input contract for both report tiers (task 42).

sample_status.description: Derived status (CONSTITUTION.md principle 7, task 42 §3.1). `invalid_input` (task 61) means the uploaded reads failed the intake integrity check; nothing downstream ran. Never confused with the coverage gate's own `status` field, which is nested under `coverage.gate`.

coverage.description: sample_status.json (gate decision) + coverage.json (estimate/subsampling) + recruit_stats.json (RECRUIT), inlined verbatim.

intake.description: intake.json (task 61), inlined verbatim: per-file gzip/FASTQ integrity result from PARSE_SAMPLESHEET.

duplicates.description: Task 71: read IDs seen more than once across the sample's input files. `identical` repeats are removed by DEDUPLICATE; `conflicting` repeats (same ID, different record) make the sample invalid. Absent when a structural error stopped the check.

deduplication.description: Task 71: whether DEDUPLICATE ran for this sample, with its record counts. Added by COLLATE.

read_qc.description: Raw/clean NanoPlot NanoStats.txt (task 43a §4.1), plus a derived filter-yield summary. Null only for `invalid_input` samples, where no QC ran. A missing or malformed NanoStats.txt leaves its section null and sets `unavailable_reason`.

assembly.description: assembly_info.txt (per-contig stats) + bin_metadata.json (C3 binning decision), inlined.

rotation.description: ROTATE_TARGET's rotation.json (schema wf5/rotation/v1): whether each circular animal_mt contig was rotated to start at an anchor gene (COX1 first), and why not when it was not. Null when the stage did not run.

homology.description: Top BLAST hit per target contig (qaccver saccver pident length qcovs evalue bitscore stitle).

annotation.description: annotation_summary.json, inlined in full (task 42 §5.4) — gene-name-bearing lists additionally carry a canonical form alongside the raw annotator spelling (task 42 §5.3).

provenance.description: CONSTITUTION.md rule 16 — tool versions, pipeline commit, reference-bundle version, and the full genetic-code candidate list.
